div.div:
• Correlation: contextId is the mesh correlation id, mirrored in the a2a-correlation-id header.
• Continuation: a follow-up SendMessage carries an existing taskId (e.g. resuming after AUTH_REQUIRED).
• Wire format: plain JSON (UTF-8), no Schema Registry wire prefix. Record key = entity id, so each entity stays ordered.
• Growing the mesh: an Agent Card, a request topic and a subscription. Agents never call each other directly.
• Business data never travels on this plane; agents read context through MCP tools.

• Growing the mesh: an Agent Card, a request topic and a subscription. Agents never call each other directly.
• Business data never travels on this plane; agents read context through MCP tools.
